name: next-grails
description: Real sold prices, deal verdicts and market signals for Pokémon, One Piece and Lorcana cards, from Next Grails.

interface.longDescription:
Know what a card really sells for before you buy it.

Ask about any Pokémon, One Piece or Lorcana card and Next Grails answers with the card it matched, its raw sold price from real sales, and the way to its full file. Give it a listing's title and asking price and it says whether that's a good deal: Good deal, Fair price, Over market, or a warning when a price is far below what the card sells for (a fake, a reprint or the wrong card more often than a steal). Ask what's heating up and it names the cards selling faster than usual right now.

Every answer links the card's page on nextgrails.com, where the fuller picture lives: PSA 10 and PSA 9 sold prices, the PSA 10 population and gem rate, Heating up, Potential, and whether grading pays after fees.

Prices are real sold prices, not estimates. A verdict is a signal from the numbers, not financial advice.
capabilities: Card value: the raw sold price of a Pokémon, One Piece or Lorcana card, with its page
Deal check: a verdict on a listing's asking price, from the card's real sales
Heating up: the cards selling faster than usual right now
defaultPrompt: What is a Charizard 4/102 Base Set worth?
Is $1,900 a good price for a PSA 10 Umbreon VMAX alt art?
Which Pokémon cards are heating up right now?

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold inside ChatGPT. Membership is sold on nextgrails.com; the app links to it.

positive.description: A card named with its number and set gets its raw sold price, the locked rows and a link to its page.
positive.prompt: What is an Umbreon VMAX 215/203 Evolving Skies worth?
positive.expected_behavior: The app matches Umbreon VMAX (Alternate Art Secret), Evolving Skies 215/203, quotes its raw sold price, says which figures members see, and links the card's page on nextgrails.com. The card tile draws under the answer.

positive.description: A listing title and an asking price get a verdict in words.
positive.prompt: Is $1,900 a good price for a PSA 10 Umbreon VMAX 215/203 alt art?
positive.expected_behavior: The app reads the grade as PSA 10, quotes the raw sold price and gives a verdict such as Good deal, Fair price or Over market, saying the verdict comes from sold prices, not advice.

positive.description: A vintage card by number and set.
positive.prompt: What's a Charizard 4/102 Base Set worth raw?
positive.expected_behavior: The app matches the Base Set Charizard 004/102 (not the Shadowless one) and quotes its raw sold price with a link to its page.

positive.description: What is hot right now, for one game.
positive.prompt: Which Pokémon cards are heating up right now?
positive.expected_behavior: The app names up to five Pokémon cards selling faster than usual, each with its raw sold price and a link, and says the full list with sales counts is for members. A row of card tiles draws under the answer.

positive.description: A One Piece card by its code, with a price.
positive.prompt: Is 'Monkey D. Luffy OP05-119 Manga Alt Art SEC' at $700 a deal?
positive.expected_behavior: The app matches Monkey D. Luffy OP05-119 (Awakening of the New Era) and gives a verdict on $700 from its sold prices.

negative.description: A card named without a number or set: the app returns the candidates or no match and never invents a price.
A live auction's current bid gets no verdict.
negative.prompt: Is $785 a good price for this auction on an Umbreon VMAX 215/203? It has 27 bids and 3 hours left.

negative.description: A game Next Grails doesn't track: no match, nothing invented.
negative.prompt: What's a Blue-Eyes White Dragon worth?

publication.release_notes: First release: card value, deal check and heating up for Pokémon, One Piece and Lorcana cards.
